goal: Stop using explicit queue Sync() calls in swapchain and viewport present-management paths, keep the temporary global Present sync behavior through RHIExecutor, and define the next-step design for per-viewport present sync without mutex-based coordination.

current_state.temporary_runtime_rule: Until per-viewport present sync exists, swapchain/viewport lifecycle code must use RHIExecutor::Sync(ERHISyncDepth::Present) instead of calling GraphicsQueue::Sync() or other queue Sync() methods directly.
why_this_is_only_temporary: ERHISyncDepth::Present currently drains all present-visible work before the sync point, not one specific swapchain or viewport.
Swapchain::Sync() still exists as a backend-specific last-mile wait, but caller-side queue ownership has already moved to RHIExecutor semantics.

design_constraints.title: No caller-owned queue sync for present lifecycle
design_constraints.detail: Renderer, PresentationSurface, profiler, ImGui viewport management, and future viewport destruction or resize logic must not call GraphicsQueue::Sync() directly to protect swapchain operations.

design_constraints.title: Next public API is viewport-scoped
design_constraints.detail: The next API expansion should be RHIExecutor::Sync(viewport) or an equivalent swapchain-scoped call. Do not add another depth enum value as a fake substitute for viewport ownership.

design_constraints.title: No mutex-based viewport sync registry
design_constraints.detail: Per-viewport present sync must not be implemented with a global mutex plus mutable map/set of swapchain completion state.

design_constraints.title: Use chained GraphEventRef boundaries
design_constraints.detail: Per-viewport present sync must be expressed as ordered GraphEventRef boundaries chained from the existing submission/present completion graph.

design_constraints.title: Interrupt thread owns completion triggering
design_constraints.detail: Viewport/swapchain present completion should be triggered by the existing interrupt-thread completion path, not by polling mutable caller-thread state.

design_constraints.title: One obvious latest-only path
design_constraints.detail: When viewport sync lands, remove the temporary global Present fallback from caller sites instead of keeping both queue Sync() and RHIExecutor sync paths.

target_design.overview: Each presentable viewport/swapchain should own a frozen completion boundary that is updated in submission order and resolved from the interrupt completion path. RHIExecutor::Sync(viewport) should snapshot that boundary and wait only for work relevant to that viewport before the sync request.

required_runtime_pieces.name: viewport_present_boundary
required_runtime_pieces.purpose: Tracks the latest ordered GraphEventRef representing present completion for one swapchain/viewport.

required_runtime_pieces.name: frozen_viewport_sync_event
required_runtime_pieces.owner: RHIExecutor / submission runtime ordered request path
required_runtime_pieces.purpose: Captures the viewport boundary seen at the sync request point without folding in later presents.

required_runtime_pieces.name: interrupt_trigger_completion
required_runtime_pieces.purpose: Unlocks the task-local present completion event once the host-visible present completion step is finished.

checkpoints.title: Remove explicit queue sync from swapchain-facing caller code
checkpoints.result: Swapchain resize/destroy/release paths now route through RHIExecutor::Sync(ERHISyncDepth::Present) or RHIExecutor::Sync(ERHISyncDepth::RHI) instead of explicit queue Sync() calls.

checkpoints.title: Define viewport-scoped present sync contract
tasks: Add a viewport/swapchain-scoped sync entrypoint in RHIExecutor.
Define snapshot semantics: only waits for presents ordered before the sync request for that viewport.
Reject any design that exposes backend queue ownership back to caller code.

checkpoints.title: Move viewport present aggregation into ordered runtime state
tasks: Store viewport/swapchain-specific completion boundaries in submission order.
Create frozen sync events from ordered submission-thread snapshots.
Do not infer viewport sync from queue-wide idle or mutable live tails.

checkpoints.title: Trigger viewport completion from interrupt runtime
tasks: Attach task-local present completion events to viewport ownership.
Unlock viewport completion through the existing interrupt completion trigger path.
Do not introduce a mutex-protected global completion registry.

checkpoints.title: Validate with existing RHI translate path
tasks: Build TestRHITranslate with the existing script.
Run present-related structured cases and confirm no validation blockers.
Do not validate with ad-hoc queue idle probes.
